draft.subject: Your API question, and a first project
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Following up on your pagination question — list endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so you won't need to pull everything in one call. I'll keep that ticket open until you confirm it's sorted.

Since you're already looking at the API, the next thing that usually helps is getting your team's real work into Wrenfield: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. Best,
Nadia
